Example Boys Science Scholarship

The Example Trust helps students from every background continue their education in science.

Who can apply

This scholarship is open to boys studying in Class 12 with science subjects at any school in India.

Applicants must provide their Class 10 mark sheet, an identity document and a bank account in their own name.

What you get

Each scholar receives Rs. 20,000 per annum, paid directly into their bank account.
